next.reason: 1985 GR2: a contained program is 'a separate program that may additionally reference certain resources defined in the containing program'. 2023: a contained source element resolves names among its own names plus 'all global names that are defined in source element A' and its containers (§2023:8.4.6.2.1 GR1); it 'may reference that name without describing it again' (§2023:13.18.27.4 GR2); 'both programs may refer to data possessing the global attribute' (§2023:8.6.7 GR2) and 'to a common file connector by referring to an associated global file-name' (§2023:9.1.5 GR2); the containing unit's configuration entries 'apply to each directly or indirectly contained source unit' (§2023:12.3.4 GR1) and its SPECIAL-NAMES names 'may be referenced from any directly or indirectly contained source unit' (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR1).
